subject: Civil Engineering
title: Fire Safety in Tunnels
description: One-minute skill: Fire Safety in Tunnels.

hook.text: A fire in a tunnel reaches 1,000°C in minutes — concrete spalls, steel weakens, escape is limited.

buildup.text: Cross-passages connect parallel tunnels every 500 feet — emergency escape routes.

discovery.text: Fire-resistant concrete contains polypropylene fibers — they melt, creating channels for steam.

twist.text: Deluge systems drench the fire zone with water — limiting temperatures but creating steam risks.

climax.text: The Channel Tunnel survived two major fires — fire-rated linings and cross-passages saved lives.

punchline.text: Underground, there's nowhere for heat to go. Fire protection is survival.

quiz.question: How do polypropylene fibers in fire-resistant concrete help during a tunnel fire?
options: They strengthen the concrete at high temperatures
They melt and create channels that release steam, preventing explosive spalling
They reflect heat away from the concrete surface

details.summary: Tunnel fire safety engineering addresses prevention, detection, smoke management, structural fire resistance, egress, and firefighting access. Fires in confined tunnels reach extreme temperatures exceeding 1,000 degrees Celsius.
details.whyItMatters: Tunnel fires are among the deadliest infrastructure emergencies. The Mont Blanc, Gotthard, and Channel Tunnel fires drove fundamental changes in tunnel safety design that now protect millions of daily users.
takeaways: Tunnel fires can reach peak temperatures of 1,000-1,350 degrees Celsius
Cross-passages every 250-500 meters provide escape to a parallel safe tunnel
Fire-resistant concrete prevents catastrophic structural failure during tunnel fires

faq.question: How do modern tunnels protect against fire-induced structural collapse?
faq.answer: Concrete linings use polypropylene fibers that melt during fires, creating microchannels that release steam pressure and prevent explosive spalling. Fire-resistant board or spray coatings protect structural concrete from the most extreme heat.

faq.question: What evacuation options exist for people trapped in a tunnel fire?
faq.answer: Cross-passages connect to a parallel tunnel or dedicated escape corridor at regular intervals. Emergency exits lead to the surface where possible. Refuge rooms with independent air supply shelter people until rescue. Emergency lighting and signs guide evacuation in smoky conditions.
